title: 扇出型晶圓級封裝
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入重組晶圓、晶粒位移與 RDL 互連。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore reconstituted wafers, die shift and rdl interconnect, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 架構選擇
stages.description: 針對架構選擇完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for architecture selection, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: Chip-first 與 chip-last｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Chip-first and chip-last | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對Chip-first 與 chip-last，把「先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For chip-first and chip-last, turn "Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「Chip-first 與 chip-last」的模型：先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for chip-first and chip-last: Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Chip-first 與 chip-last的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for chip-first and chip-last, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: Chip-first 與 chip-last：機制
knowledge.text: 先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。
knowledge.textEn: Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 必須排除的錯判：兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「扇出型晶圓級封裝」的「Chip-first 與 chip-last｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Chip-first and chip-last | mechanism and design” in “Fan-out wafer-level packaging”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「Chip-first 與 chip-last」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For chip-first and chip-last — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。
兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險
平均晶粒密度足以描述翹曲
optionsEn: Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points.
Treating the routes as renamed identical risks
Using mean die density to describe warpage
quiz.explanation: 先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。 畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 因此不能採用「兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險」。
quiz.explanationEn: Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points. Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Therefore reject: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks.

steps.title: Chip-first 與 chip-last｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Chip-first and chip-last | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對Chip-first 與 chip-last，把「先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For chip-first and chip-last, turn "Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 將「兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating the routes as renamed identical risks" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Chip-first 與 chip-last的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for chip-first and chip-last: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

Use this evidence plan: Mark die, RDL, balls and keep-outs. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.title: 良品與重組地圖｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Good-die and reconstitution map | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對良品與重組地圖，把「來源晶圓與重組位置需一對一可追溯。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For good-die and reconstitution map, turn "Source wafer and reconstituted position need one-to-one traceability." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：驗證翻轉、旋轉與批次映射。 將「重組後只保留封裝編號即可」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Verify flip, rotation and lot mapping. Challenge the hypothesis "Keeping only final package IDs after reconstitution" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 驗證翻轉、旋轉與批次映射。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Verify flip, rotation and lot mapping. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：重組後只保留封裝編號即可。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Keeping only final package IDs after reconstitution. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付良品與重組地圖的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for good-die and reconstitution map: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 良品與重組地圖：機制
knowledge.text: 來源晶圓與重組位置需一對一可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Source wafer and reconstituted position need one-to-one traceability.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 驗證翻轉、旋轉與批次映射。 必須排除的錯判：重組後只保留封裝編號即可。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Verify flip, rotation and lot mapping. Misinterpretation to reject: Keeping only final package IDs after reconstitution. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「良品與重組地圖」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For good-die and reconstitution map — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 重組後只保留封裝編號即可
對位修正可以無限制拉伸配線
驗證翻轉、旋轉與批次映射。
optionsEn: Keeping only final package IDs after reconstitution
Allowing unlimited routing stretch for alignment
Verify flip, rotation and lot mapping.
quiz.explanation: 來源晶圓與重組位置需一對一可追溯。 驗證翻轉、旋轉與批次映射。 因此不能採用「重組後只保留封裝編號即可」。
quiz.explanationEn: Source wafer and reconstituted position need one-to-one traceability. Verify flip, rotation and lot mapping. Therefore reject: Keeping only final package IDs after reconstitution.
